"Sample data" in the D6 sentence and "Without it, AwardGrid shows sample data only" (since 2026-10-07, build 4): without a key the app opens on its Welcome screen, whose first button, "Try with sample data", switches every screen to made-up data generated on the device and labelled "Illustrative data — not live availability", for any route between the airports the app recognises, and sends nothing (the sample_mode claim; sample/sample-copy.ts; present.ts demo.synthetic). "The 84 airports it recognises": every code in packages/core/data/places.json has sample data, each metro code that is not itself an airport mapped to its first airport (apps/ios/src/sample/airports.ts); airports.test.ts holds the count, and the app's coverage note computes it from the same table. "The next 12 months": today and the 364 days after it, on the device's calendar (apps/ios/src/sample/generate.ts SAMPLE_DAYS).

Sample data is real program names with invented numbers (decision D10). It is not seats.aero data, so it carries no "Data: seats.aero" line ("Sample data · on this device" instead), no source time ("Sample data" instead), and no booking or program links ("Sample options have no booking links.").

Only booking links and connecting a seats.aero account are not available while sample data is on: Settings › seats.aero account says to exit sample data to connect.

"Nothing is sent": sample mode's transport answers in memory and never calls the native HTTP adapter or the WebView's fetch (sample-fetch.ts), and its key is an in-memory placeholder that is never saved or sent (boot.ts). The step-20 Simulator QA (2026-10-07, three devices) saw no request to seats.aero in sample mode.
